```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(eco230r)
library(knitr)

airbnb <- read_csv("data/airbnb_chicago.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Select and calculate

```{r}
listing_data <- airbnb |>
  select(
    property_type, room_type, host_since, number_of_reviews,
    beds, bedrooms, bathrooms, listed_price, review_scores_rating
  ) |>
  mutate(
    reviews_per_bed = if_else(
      !is.na(beds) & beds > 0,
      number_of_reviews / beds,
      NA_real_
    )
  )
```

## Summarize groups

```{r}
listing_data |>
  group_by(room_type) |>
  summarise(
    listings = n(),
    median_price = median(listed_price, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_review_score = mean(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 1)
```

## Filter and categorize

```{r}
listing_data <- listing_data |>
  filter(!is.na(reviews_per_bed), reviews_per_bed >= 1) |>
  mutate(
    price_category = cut(
      listed_price,
      breaks = c(0, 100, 200, 300, 400, Inf),
      labels = c("$1-$100", "$101-$200", "$201-$300", "$301-$400", "$401+")
    )
  )
```

## Parse dates and combine steps

```{r}
analysis <- listing_data |>
  mutate(
    host_since_date = mdy(host_since),
    host_since_year = year(host_since_date)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(host_since_year), !is.na(review_scores_rating)) |>
  group_by(property_type) |>
  summarise(
    listings = n(),
    median_price = median(listed_price, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_review_score = mean(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(listings >= 30) |>
  arrange(desc(listings))

analysis |> kable(digits = 1)
```
